sample_unit: NIH mental health patient education materials

links.outcome: Reading grade level of NIH mental health patient education materials versus seventh-grade recommendation
links.effect: Mean Flesch-Kincaid grade levels were 8.74 (Readable), 10.44 (ChatGPT), and 9.58 (Claude), above the seventh-grade target. Coleman-Liau averaged 14.29.
links.quote: NIH mental health PEMs consistently exceeded the seventh-grade reading level and should be revised to adhere to NIH recommendations.

unlisted_practices: Using generative AI chatbots to assess the readability of patient education materials

screen.reason: The study evaluates the use of AI chatbots (ChatGPT and Claude) compared to traditional software to calculate readability metrics of patient education materials.
